An '''Imperial research facility''' was an in operation on the planet [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GP" />

==History==
{{Quote|The lab knows nothing about the intelligence these creatures are exhibiting. [...] The Empire would have paid quite well for these if we had actually made it to...|The last datapad entry from a GeneTech Syndicate member|<ref name="SWG:GD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Grim Discovery|Talus}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[GeneTech Syndicate]], a biotechnology company [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab|based]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], was conducting a dangerous [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]] program. The objective was to create an intelligent and powerful form of [[arachne]]s for the use of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those arachnes could be released onto a world the Empire did not want to spend troops on, but did not want it to be used by its enemies. Even though the creatures would thoroughly destroy the native ecology, the planet would be effectively rendered uninhabitable.<ref name="SWG:G">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Genocide|Talus}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the project was a success and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vigh]], the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|chief scientist]] of the GeneTech Syndicate, decided to deliver the first specimens to the Empire. Bioengineered arachnes were loaded into a transport that headed to the Imperial research facility on Nubia. However, the transport crashed in the mountains near the city of [[Nashal]] just after its departure and the arachnes escaped in the wilderness.<ref name="GP" /> Moreover, the arachnes in the GeneTech Syndicate laboratory escaped containment and overwhelmed their creators. The [[Corellian Security Force]] eventually discovered that most of the lab staff was slaughtered by the creatures.<ref name="SWG:G" />
